description.zh: 补出时间序列里缺失的一项：从生活事件的先后，到一天与四季的循环、一星期七天，再到 12 小时钟面上的间隔。训练的是把时间理解成有序、会循环的序列，尤其是『转完一圈又回到起点』。
description.en: Fill the missing item in a time sequence: from the order of everyday events, to the cycles of the day and seasons, the seven-day week, and intervals on a 12-hour clock. What it trains is understanding time as an ordered sequence that cycles — especially that going all the way round returns to the start.

designModel.zh: 主轴是时间概念（事件先后 → 一天/四季 → 星期 → 钟面），同时周期长度逐级变长（无 → 4 → 7 → 12）。K2 起每道循环题都一定跨越周期边界（冬→春、周日→周一、12→1），这是区分『会背顺序』与『理解循环』的关键。
designModel.en: The primary axis is the time concept (event order, day/seasons, week, clock face), with cycle length growing alongside (none, 4, 7, 12). From K2 every cycle item crosses the cycle boundary (winter to spring, Sunday to Monday, 12 to 1) — the step that separates reciting an order from understanding a cycle.

ageRange.noteZh: 生活事件先后 3-4 岁即可；跨 12 点的钟面间隔约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: Everyday event order suits ages 3-4; clock intervals crossing 12 suit about age 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列。与 motion-pattern 的区别：后者是空间中的运动，本模块是时间与事件。钟面间隔与 number-pattern 的等差数列相关，但重点在 12 进位的循环，而非加法本身。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds. Unlike motion-pattern, which covers motion in space, this module covers time and events. Clock intervals relate to number-pattern's constant-step sequences, but the focus is the 12-hour wrap, not addition itself.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.PATTERN.TEMPORAL.SEQUENCE，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.PATTERN.TEMPORAL.SEQUENCE, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: event-order 是人工审定的生活事件链（起床→刷牙→吃早餐→上学 等），生成器只挑链，不编顺序；day-season 是早中晚夜与春夏秋冬；week 是周一到周日；clock 是 12 小时钟面上的整点。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: event-order uses hand-curated everyday chains (wake up, brush teeth, breakfast, school, etc.) — the generator only picks a chain and never invents an order; day-season covers times of day and the four seasons; week is Monday to Sunday; clock is whole hours on a 12-hour face.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 事件链不循环记为 none；一天/四季是 4；星期是 7；钟面是 12。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: Event chains do not cycle and are recorded as none; day and seasons are 4; the week is 7; the clock face is 12.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: end 是『接下来是什么』；any 空格可能在中间，需要前后对照。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: end asks what comes next; any may put the gap mid-strip, requiring a check against both sides.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: K1 给 3 个选项，之后都是 4 个。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: K1 offers three options; later grades offer four.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 6 题，通过线 75%（5/6）。循环题由 generator.js 现生成；生活事件题从人工审定的事件链中抽取，干扰项只取同链前面的步骤或不同领域链的事件，保证不会有同样合理的第二个答案。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Six items per run, passing at 75% (5/6). Cycle items are generated by generator.js; event items are drawn from hand-curated chains, with distractors taken only from earlier steps of the same chain or from chains of a different domain, so no second answer is equally reasonable.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 看三件生活中先后发生的事，选出接下来会发生的事。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Given three everyday events in order, pick what happens next.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 早中晚夜、春夏秋冬循环，序列一定跨过『夜晚→早上』或『冬天→春天』。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Times of day and seasons cycle, and the strip always crosses night-to-morning or winter-to-spring.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 连续五天的星期序列，空格可能在中间，排除相邻两天与非星期的干扰。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Five consecutive days of the week with the gap possibly mid-strip; reject neighbouring days and non-day distractors.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 钟面上每次过 2-4 小时，序列一定跨过 12 点，补出缺失的整点。
levelMap.objectiveEn: On a clock face 2-4 hours pass each time and the strip always crosses 12; fill in the missing hour.

statistics.noteZh: optionTypes 中 cycle_misalign（选了相邻项）说明顺序大致知道但错位，category_confusion（选了别的周期里的项）说明还没分清时间单位。
statistics.noteEn: In optionTypes, cycle_misalign (a neighbouring item) means the order is roughly known but slipped, while category_confusion (an item from another cycle) means the time units are not yet separated.
